title: How Fatal School Shootings Impact a Community's Consumption
eligible_reason: Closest call in this batch, judged ineligible. Study 1 stacks 63 incident windows (24 weeks before and after each fatal school shooting) and uses the same households one year earlier as a placebo control. Week fixed effects are defined relative to the treatment week (event time), not calendar time, so the regression is an event-aligned stacked design. It also includes household controls, and the Advan/SafeGraph analysis uses synthetic DiD.
design_notes: JMR 62(6), 2025. Equation (1): Y_hw = alpha + beta*FSS_hw + mu_h + lambda_w + delta*X_hw + e_hw. h = NielsenIQ Homescan household in a county with a fatal school shooting; w = week; FSS_hw = 1 if the household's county had a shooting by week w (table label 'FSS incident x post (DiD)'); mu_h = household FE; lambda_w = week-relative-to-treatment FE; X_hw = household income, residence type, race, school-age children (the text says it captures 'changes in a household's income'). Each incident contributes 48 weeks in the shooting year and 48 weeks in the prior year (control); N = 8,275 households x 48 weeks x 2 years = 794,400. SEs clustered by household. 63 incidents, 2012-2019 (40 in liberal-leaning, 23 in conservative-leaning counties by 2012 county vote). Table 3 outcome = weekly food spending in dollars; Table 4 outcomes = shopping days, unique stores, unique departments, weekly trips. Table 5 = synthetic DiD ATT on log(total spend) and visit counts for NAICS 445 and 722 using SafeGraph/Advan (2019-2022), neighbor counties as controls. Parallel-trends evidence and the neighboring-county control are in Web Appendices D and E (not main text). No event-study figure or modern estimators in the main text.
estimators_reported: event-aligned stacked DiD with prior-year placebo control and household FE
screener_notes: Not eligible. Stacked, event-time design with week-relative FE (no calendar-time FE), household time-varying controls, and a prior-year placebo control; Table 5 is synthetic DiD. If the lead wants event-aligned windows treated as eligible, re-estimation would need household-by-incident stacking, which the protocol excludes. Data: NielsenIQ Homescan via the Kilts Center (licensed), Advan and SafeGraph via Dewey (licensed), CHDS K-12 shooting database (public). No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.

ineligible_specs.reason: stacked event-aligned design; relative-week FE; time-varying household controls
